# Synthetic intake fixture — not a real research project

We have a small industrial defect detection project. A detector sometimes misses
tiny flaws. There is a baseline training script and a folder of images, but this
fixture supplies no train/validation/test roles, batch grouping, previous result
files, allowed changes, compute allocation, or current experiment ownership.
